messages:
sanjay: Re-opening the postmortem action register to consolidate owners and surface a couple of recurring patterns we noticed (early-morning spikes, model A causing most pressure). Please claim or reassign.

marta: I'll keep the quota ticket but want a clearer temporary target. Can we aim for +30% reserved for 72h and reevaluate with telemetry?

jordan: I'll take scheduler follow-ups. Pattern note: backpressure correlates with many short-turn requests that queue and then trigger long generations. My plan: per-route batch_window_ms reduction for routes tagged latency:high, and increase max_pending by 10% across the board. Canary on gpu-probe-1. ETA Tue COB.

ana: I'll do the pattern analysis and add the model-level topo to the incident doc. I can generate a CSV with 1m peaks per model for the last 7 days. ETA Thu.

sanjay: Good. Two additional items: 1) add an automatic approval guard for small temporary quota increases (<+40 GPUs, <72h) to avoid approval delay during surges; 2) schedule a retrospective after the remediation closes to verify recurrence stopped. Thoughts?

tess: I'll own the runbook update and the retrospective checklist. I'll add a section "when to request auto-approval" and include the exact infra form text + rollback steps. PR will include runnable commands (`rbctl scale --pool=reserved-gpu --min=18`, `rbctl set-autoscaler --pool=reserved-gpu --min-free=12`). ETA Wed AM.

marta: Auto-approval sounds risky without billing guardrails. Can billing provide a cost cap? ops-bot, can you stub a cost cap check in the queue?

ops-bot: Created ticket GPU-900 (quota auto-approval policy) and GPU-901 (scheduler canary). Links: https://tracker.internal/GPU-900, GPU-901.

ops-bot: Suggested billing guard: auto-approve only if estimated 72h incremental cost < $7k and owner provides short justification.

jordan: For the canary I'll attach a replay script that reproduces the early-morning spike pattern. Smoke test pass criteria: p95 latency within +8% of baseline and queue depth not higher than baseline + 20. If we fail, rollback immediately.

ana: Pattern analysis note: model A accounts for ~62% of the 02:00-03:00 spikes, often when upstream batch jobs hit QPS bursts. I'll add an action to coordinate with the model product owner to smooth traffic or move heavy jobs to a different window. ETA Thu EOD.

sanjay: Summarize action register (canonical):
- QUOTA AUTO-APPROVAL: define policy + billing cap (owner: marta, ops-bot), ETA Fri EOD
- SCHEDULER CANARY: tune + smoke tests (owner: jordan), ETA Tue COB
- RUNBOOK + RETRO: add auto-approval text + retrospective checklist (owner: tess), ETA Wed AM
- PATTERN ANALYSIS: model-level breakdown + remediation suggestion (owner: ana), ETA Thu EOD
- TELEMETRY: 1m headroom, per-model QPS tile + incident trigger for headroom<10% (owner: ops-bot), ETA Thu EOD

marta: Claiming quota auto-approval policy. ETA Fri 18:00 UTC. I'll loop in billing for the cost cap.

jordan: ETA Tue COB (canary results + PR).

tess: ETA Wed AM (runbook PR + retrospective checklist).

ana: ETA Thu EOD (CSV + suggested smoothing windows for model owners).

ops-bot: Added recurring "GPU postmortem short-check" weekly for 4 weeks Wednesdays 09:30 UTC. Linked tickets: GPU-900, GPU-901. Calendar: https://calendar.internal/e/pt-900.

sanjay: Please paste final ETAs here so I can lock this into the follow-up note. We'll escalate to oncall if any ETA slips more than 48h.

marta: ETA Fri 18:00 UTC.

jordan: ETA Tue COB.

tess: ETA Wed AM.

ana: ETA Thu EOD.

ops-bot: Incident summary appended: recurring early-morning spikes, model A dominant. Open actions GPU-900..GPU-904.

sanjay: Thanks everyone. I'll publish the follow-up doc and ping execs once quota auto-approval policy is drafted. If blockers appear, post here and we'll triage. :mag:
